tasks.label: k8s: cluster up
tasks.detail: Create the kind cluster + helm install LUCARIO. Idempotent.

tasks.label: k8s: cluster down (full teardown)
tasks.detail: Delete the kind cluster and all data.

tasks.label: k8s: pause cluster (data preserved)
tasks.detail: Stop the kind node container. All cluster state and PVC data survive; resume with 'k8s: resume cluster'.

tasks.label: k8s: resume cluster
tasks.detail: Start the kind node container previously paused with 'k8s: pause cluster'. Kubelet reconciles pods automatically.

tasks.label: k8s: telepresence connect
tasks.detail: Bridge host DNS into the cluster (cluster DNS resolves from laptop). Pins telepresence to kind-lucario-dev via --context without mutating your kubectl current-context.
args: set -e; kubectl config get-contexts -o name | grep -qx kind-lucario-dev || { echo 'error: kubectl context kind-lucario-dev not found; run deployment/helm/dev/k8s-up.sh first' >&2; exit 1; }; telepresence connect --context kind-lucario-dev -n lucario

tasks.label: k8s: telepresence intercept api_server
tasks.detail: Idempotently connect + intercept api_server. Pins telepresence to kind-lucario-dev via --context without mutating your kubectl current-context. Env comes from your own .vscode/.env.k8s (copy from .env.k8s.template). Auto-injects the cluster-random OPENSEARCH_ADMIN_PASSWORD (from the lucario-opensearch Secret) and ENCRYPTION_KEY_SECRET (from the lucario-encryption-key Secret) so the laptop api_server encrypts with the same key the in-cluster sandbox-proxy decrypts with. Wired as preLaunchTask on every (k8s) launch config.
args: set -e; KUBE='kubectl --context kind-lucario-dev'; ENV_FILE="${workspaceFolder}/.vscode/.env.k8s"; kubectl config get-contexts -o name | grep -qx kind-lucario-dev || { echo 'error: kubectl context kind-lucario-dev not found; run deployment/helm/dev/k8s-up.sh first' >&2; exit 1; }; [ -f "$ENV_FILE" ] || { echo 'error: .vscode/.env.k8s not found; copy .vscode/.env.k8s.template and fill in <REPLACE THIS> values (see docs/dev/local-kubernetes.md).' >&2; exit 1; }; OS_PW=$($KUBE -n lucario get secret lucario-opensearch -o jsonpath='{.data.opensearch_admin_password}' 2>/dev/null | base64 -d || true); [ -n "$OS_PW" ] || { echo 'error: could not read opensearch admin password from Secret lucario-opensearch/lucario; is the cluster up?' >&2; exit 1; }; TMP=$(mktemp); awk -v pw="$OS_PW" 'BEGIN{f=0} /^OPENSEARCH_ADMIN_PASSWORD=/{print "OPENSEARCH_ADMIN_PASSWORD=" pw; f=1; next} {print} END{if(!f) print "OPENSEARCH_ADMIN_PASSWORD=" pw}' "$ENV_FILE" > "$TMP" && mv "$TMP" "$ENV_FILE"; ENC_KEY=$($KUBE -n lucario get secret lucario-encryption-key -o jsonpath='{.data.encryption_key_secret}' 2>/dev/null | base64 -d || true); [ -n "$ENC_KEY" ] || { echo 'error: could not read encryption key from Secret lucario-encryption-key/lucario; is the cluster up?' >&2; exit 1; }; TMP2=$(mktemp); awk -v k="$ENC_KEY" 'BEGIN{f=0} /^ENCRYPTION_KEY_SECRET=/{print "ENCRYPTION_KEY_SECRET=" k; f=1; next} {print} END{if(!f) print "ENCRYPTION_KEY_SECRET=" k}' "$ENV_FILE" > "$TMP2" && mv "$TMP2" "$ENV_FILE"; telepresence connect --context kind-lucario-dev -n lucario; telepresence leave lucario-api-server 2>/dev/null || true; telepresence intercept lucario-api-server --namespace lucario --port 8080:8080 --mount=false

tasks.label: k8s: telepresence quit
tasks.detail: Tear down all telepresence intercepts and disconnect.

tasks.label: k8s: alembic upgrade head
tasks.detail: Run `alembic upgrade head` against the in-cluster Postgres (lucario-pg-rw). Idempotently connects telepresence to kind-lucario-dev so cluster DNS resolves, then loads DB env from .vscode/.env.k8s via python-dotenv.
args: set -e; kubectl config get-contexts -o name | grep -qx kind-lucario-dev || { echo 'error: kubectl context kind-lucario-dev not found; run deployment/helm/dev/k8s-up.sh first' >&2; exit 1; }; ENV_FILE="${workspaceFolder}/.vscode/.env.k8s"; [ -f "$ENV_FILE" ] || { echo 'error: .vscode/.env.k8s not found; copy .vscode/.env.k8s.template and fill in <REPLACE THIS> values (see docs/dev/local-kubernetes.md).' >&2; exit 1; }; [ -x "${workspaceFolder}/.venv/bin/python" ] || { echo 'error: ${workspaceFolder}/.venv/bin/python not found; run `uv sync` first.' >&2; exit 1; }; telepresence connect --context kind-lucario-dev -n lucario; cd "${workspaceFolder}/backend" && "${workspaceFolder}/.venv/bin/python" -m dotenv -f "$ENV_FILE" run -- alembic upgrade head

tasks.label: craft: up (cluster + sandbox image + .env.k8s)
tasks.detail: One-command Craft setup: kind cluster + LUCARIO helm install + sandbox image build/load + .env.k8s bootstrap. Idempotent.

tasks.label: craft: down (teardown + telepresence quit)
tasks.detail: Symmetric teardown: telepresence quit + delete kind cluster. Does not touch .vscode/.env.k8s. Pass --remove-images to also remove locally-built sandbox/backend images.

tasks.label: craft: rebuild sandbox image
tasks.detail: Rebuild onyxdotapp/sandbox:dev and load it into the kind node. Use after editing backend/lucario/server/features/build/sandbox/image/.
args: docker build -t onyxdotapp/sandbox:dev backend/lucario/server/features/build/sandbox/image && kind load docker-image onyxdotapp/sandbox:dev --name lucario-dev
